links.quote: On the other hand, RAG did not improve performance on classification labels produced from radiology reports, which could be due to the imprecise nature of the descriptions contained within the reports, rendering the extra data less useful and providing an opportunity for future training.

links.outcome: LLM classification performance given imprecise real-world radiology report descriptions versus ideal descriptions
links.effect: Agreement fell from almost perfect at bone/location level to slight at subgroup level (accuracy 0.09 zero-shot) on radiology reports; ideal descriptions performed better.
links.quote: The consequence was that the LLM classifications could only be as precise as the descriptions they were generated from.
